Breaking News 🚨India reports its first case of HMPV virus: an 8-month-old baby in Bangalore tests positive.The child, with no travel history, was hospitalized for fever, and a blood test confirmed the virus.
The case has been reported to the Union Health Ministry. India Alert! https://t.co/dESbBUOarE
